| Hyperparameter                                                         | Value                                              |
|:-----------------------------------------------------------------------|:---------------------------------------------------|
| Input dims (text, audio, vision)                                       | 768, 5, 20                                         |

| LR schedule                                                            | cosine annealing, η_min = 0, T_max = epochs        |
| Epochs / batch size / grad clip                                        | 30 / 32 / 1.0                                      |
| Loss weights λ1 (BCE) / λ2 (unimodal) / λ3 (MMR-rec)                   | 0.5 / 0.1 / 0 (0.1 for MMR-rec)                    |
| Model selection                                                        | lowest validation MAE under the training condition |
| Seeds                                                                  | 7, 13, 17, 42, 99                                  |
